students.name: Sneha Reddy
students.vacating_reason: Final semester completed. Relocating for corporate internship.

complaints.title: Intermittent Wi-Fi signal in room A-201
complaints.description: The 5GHz Wi-Fi signal keeps dropping frequently every evening between 7 PM and 10 PM. Speed tests show under 2 Mbps during peak study hours.
complaints.admin_remarks: IT team scheduled a dual-band access point installation on Floor 2 tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM.

complaints.title: Attached bathroom drainage pipe slow flow
complaints.description: Water drains very slowly after shower in the attached bathroom. Requires plumbing unblocking check.
complaints.admin_remarks: Housekeeping and plumbing technician cleared the hair trap and flushed pipe on 2026-11-12.

complaints.title: Study desk power outlet loose connection
complaints.description: The 3-pin power socket near bed #4 sparks slightly when laptop charger is plugged in. Needs socket plate replacement.
complaints.admin_remarks: Assigned to Campus Electrician Mr. Mohan for inspection.

complaints.title: Low water pressure in 3rd floor washrooms
complaints.description: Between 6:30 AM and 8:00 AM, common washroom taps have low pressure due to pump scheduling.
complaints.admin_remarks: Facility team is adjusting overhead booster pump timers.

notices.title: Annual Hostel Sports & Badminton Tournament
notices.author: Chief Warden Office
notices.content: Registrations are now open for the Inter-Block Table Tennis and Badminton Tournament starting this Saturday, 21st November in the indoor sports complex. Attractive trophies and cash prizes for winning blocks!

notices.title: Scheduled Solar Geyser System Maintenance
notices.author: Facility Maintenance Dept
notices.content: Routine cleaning and descaling of solar hot water collector panels will take place on Sunday, 15th November between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Hot water will resume normally via electrical backup by 4:00 PM.

notices.title: Dining Hall Special Festive Menu Feedback
notices.author: Student Mess Committee
notices.content: The student mess committee invites all residents to submit their menu suggestions for the upcoming winter feast. Please submit your recommendations through the complaint/feedback portal by Wednesday.

notices.title: Hostel Gate Timings & Safety Guidelines Reminder
notices.author: Chief Security Officer
notices.content: All students are reminded that main hostel entry gates close strictly at 10:30 PM. Late entry requires prior approval on the student dashboard or permission letter from department HOD.
